brief.headline: KKR founders join €1.25bn Valencia football club investment
bullets: M&A & Buyouts: The family offices of KKR co-founders Henry Kravis and George Roberts have joined a US investment consortium acquiring a 42% stake in Spanish football club Valencia CF, in a transaction valuing the club at €1.25bn, according to a report by the Financial Times.
Real Estate: Audi intends to invest approximately $4 billion in a manufacturing site at the Middle Georgia Megasite on Route 96 near Interstate 75.
People & Leadership: KKR has appointed Brian J. Lee, the former chief risk officer of the Goldman Sachs Group, to its board of directors.
Hotels & Hospitality: Accor reported its third-quarter 2026 results.
Real Estate: UK property development lender CrowdProperty has secured a £100m forward flow partnership with ColCap Financial UK to direct private capital to small and regional housebuilders.
brief.marketRead: Bottom line: calm volatility and open credit markets are a supportive backdrop for dealmaking, fundraising and exits. The S&P 500 stands at 7,757.17 (up 0.6% on the prior reading) and the VIX is 19.4, a normal-volatility reading. The effective fed funds rate is 3.88%, the 10-year Treasury yield is 4.96% (down 17 bps on the prior reading) and the 10Y–2Y yield curve is +0.31 pts (positively sloped). High-yield credit spreads are 3.38%, near long-run norms (down 2 bps on the prior reading).
